title: 第672章 老神仙日常672第679章 老神仙日常679
content_zh:
白九思眼睛越眯越紧，渐渐手掌也换了位置，他掐住了应渊的脖子，龇着牙问道，“这有什么难回答的？”
应渊回了神儿，轻笑了一声握住了白九思的手腕，“没有什么难回答的。”
白九思挑眉，“你最喜欢哪个？！”
应渊抬手，勾着唇角点了点白九思鼻尖，“我是谁？”
“你说你是谁？”白九思撇了撇嘴角，“应渊帝君自己不知道自己是谁吗？怎么还来问我？”
应渊哼笑起来，将仍然扼着自己脖颈的手拉开，仰头亲了上去。
白九思躲开。
“傻乎乎的小笨蛋。”
白九思红了脸颊，“你说谁？”
“你呀~”应渊哼笑着又贴了上去，啄了啄白九思的鼻尖，轻声说道，“你是赵孝谦时，我是谁？”
“谢淮安。”白九思双臂环上了应渊的脖颈。
“你是武拾光时，我又是谁？”
“禹司凤。”白九思勾起了唇角。
“那你说，我喜欢谁？”应渊点了点白九思的鼻尖，双手捧住了白九思的脸颊，捏了捏，抬头吻了上去。
白九思哼哼地笑，半张着口接住了应渊的吻。
“傻瓜~”应渊松了口，仰着头啄了啄白九思红彤彤的眼睛，“和你说正事，你就说这些有的没的。”
白九思晃着身体，不依不饶地说道，“这怎么是有的没的，这才是正事儿。”
他低垂着眼眸，眼神儿留恋地在应渊脸上逡巡，“你到底最喜欢谁？”
“应渊，喜欢白九思。”应渊再次捧住了白九思的脸颊，“谢淮安喜欢赵孝谦，禹司凤喜欢武拾光。”
白九思红着脸哼哼地笑了起来。

“我，最爱你~”说了这句，应渊又仰着头吻了上去。
白九思腿软脚软，心软的能化成水，“孩子可以以后再生，我要同你一起下界去。”
应渊蹙眉，“生了孩子，改了你的鸿蒙血脉，舅父早些同意咱们的婚事不好吗？”
白九思“嗯~嗯”了一声，轻轻摇了摇头，整个人贴在了应渊身上，“你下了界，便会变成了另外一个人，若是喜欢上了别人……”
“这么没有信心吗？”应渊勾着唇角笑了起来，“对我没有信心，对你自己也没有信心吗？”
白九思摇头，“你是我的，是我一个人的。”
应渊哼哼地笑了起来。
“不许笑，你换了身份，难道就不是你了吗？”白九思瘪起了唇角，“你喜欢上了别人，我、我就去杀了他。”
“杀了他？”应渊又蹙起眉来。
白九思眯起眼睛，“杀了他，回来带走吱吱和小小，叫你永远看不见他们……”
应渊眉头越蹙越紧，半晌，他将手掌贴在了白九思的心口处，“不可执着。”
白九思挺直了腰杆，“你在说些什么风凉话？”
“心魔……”
“我管他什么魔，你敢喜欢别人，我就是成了……”
应渊一把捂住了白九思的口，瞪圆了眼睛，“不许乱说！”
白九思只觉眼睛酸涩，他眨了眨眼睛，心头难受，猛吸了一口气，他瞪圆了眼睛，“你要抛夫弃子？！”
content_en:
Bai Jiusi's eyes narrowed tighter and tighter, and gradually his palms changed positions. He grabbed Ying Yuan's neck and asked with bared teeth, "What's so difficult to answer?"
Ying Yuan came back to his senses, chuckled and held Bai Jiusi's wrist, "There's nothing difficult to answer."
Bai Jiusi raised his eyebrows, "Which one do you like best?!"
Ying Yuan raised his hand, raised the corners of his lips and tapped the tip of Bai Jiusi's nose, "Who am I?"
"Who do you think you are?" Bai Jiusi curled his lips, "Don't Emperor Ying Yuan know who he is? Why are you still asking me?"
Ying Yuan laughed, pulled away the hand that was still holding his neck, raised his head and kissed her.
Bai Jiusi ducked away.
"Silly little fool."
Bai Jiusi's cheeks turned red, "Who are you talking about?"
"You~" Ying Yuan smiled and leaned forward again, pecking the tip of Bai Jiusi's nose, and said softly, "When you are Zhao Xiaoqian, who am I?"
"Thank you Huaian." Bai Jiusi put his arms around Ying Yuan's neck.
"When you are Wu Shiguang, who am I?"
"Yu Sifeng." Bai Jiusi raised the corners of his lips.
"Then tell me, who do I like?" Ying Yuan tapped the tip of Bai Jiusi's nose, held Bai Jiusi's cheeks with both hands, squeezed them, raised his head and kissed them.
Bai Jiusi chuckled and accepted Ying Yuan's kiss with his mouth half open.
"Fool~" Ying Yuan relaxed, raised his head and pecked Bai Jiusi's red eyes, "When I talk to you about business, just tell me whether you have these things or not."
Bai Jiusi shook his body and said reluctantly, "How come this is something that is not there? This is business."
He lowered his eyes and lingered on Ying Yuan's face, "Who do you like the most?"
"Ying Yuan, I like Bai Jiusi." Ying Yuan held Bai Jiusi's cheek again, "Xie Huai'an likes Zhao Xiaoqian, and Yu Sifeng likes Wu Shiguang."
Bai Jiusi blushed and laughed.
"I love you the most~" After saying this, Ying Yuan raised his head and kissed her again.
Bai Jiusi's legs were soft and her feet were soft, and her heart was so soft that she could turn into water. "The child can be born again later. I want to go to the lower world with you."
Ying Yuan frowned, "Having a child has changed your Hongmeng bloodline. Wouldn't it be better for uncle to agree to our marriage earlier?"
Bai Jiusi said "Hmm~hmm", shook his head slightly, and pressed his whole body against Ying Yuan, "When you leave the world, you will become another person. If you fall in love with someone else..."
"Do you have so little confidence?" Ying Yuan raised the corners of his lips and smiled, "Have you no confidence in me, or in yourself?"
Bai Jiusi shook his head, "You are mine and mine alone."
Ying Yuan chuckled.
"Don't laugh. If you changed your identity, wouldn't it be you?" Bai Jiusi pursed her lips, "If you fall in love with someone else, I, I will kill him."
"Kill him?" Ying Yuan frowned again.
Bai Jiusi narrowed his eyes, "Kill him, come back and take away Zhizhi and Xiaoxiao, so that you will never see them again..."
Ying Yuan's brows furrowed tighter and tighter. After a while, he put his palm against Bai Jiusi's heart and said, "Don't be persistent."
Bai Jiusi straightened his back, "What are you talking about?"
"Inner demon..."
"I don't care what kind of devil he is, if you dare to like others, I will become..."
Ying Yuan covered Bai Jiusi's mouth and widened his eyes, "Don't talk nonsense!"
Bai Jiusi felt his eyes were sore. He blinked and felt uncomfortable. He took a sharp breath and his eyes widened, "You want to abandon your husband and son?!"
